walkthroughs.body_html: Biodegradable plastics are often greenwashed; many only break down in industrial composters at 50 to 60 C, not in oceans or home compost bins. Compostable plastics must meet standards like EN 13432 and break down within 12 weeks in a composter. PLA bioplastic from corn is biological in origin but does not biodegrade in marine conditions.

EPR shifts the cost of waste from local councils onto producers. UK packaging EPR began in 2024, with producers paying based on weight, material and recyclability. This rewards eco-design: lightweighting, single materials and clear recyclability. France, Germany and South Korea have mature EPR systems for batteries, e-waste and textiles too.

UN member states agreed in 2022 to negotiate a legally binding Global Plastics Treaty. The aim is to cut plastic pollution across the lifecycle, including production caps, design rules, chemical restrictions and waste management. Negotiations continued into 2024-2025. Strong treaty outcomes could transform global plastic flows by 2040.
